intro_narration.caption: The GPU silo, a data centre for regional and rural locations.
intro_narration.say: The G P U silo, a data centre for regional and rural locations.

intro_narration.caption: More than 18,000 GPUs powered by 50MW of gas turbine power, contained within a 100 foot tall concrete silo with a footprint of just 0.2 acres.
intro_narration.say: More than eighteen thousand GPUs powered by fifty megawatts of gas turbine power, contained within a hundred-foot-tall concrete silo with a footprint of just zero point two acres.

intro_narration.caption: The closed loop cooling system requires no mains water.
intro_narration.say: The closed-loop cooling system requires no mains water.

intro_narration.caption: Full designs are Open Sourced on GitHub.
intro_narration.say: Full designs are open sourced on Git Hub.

headline: The GPU silo, a data centre
for regional and rural locations
specs: 100 foot tall concrete silo on 0.2 acres
No water or electricity mains connection

revised_cues.title: Pod receiving
revised_cues.spec: 4 Vera Rubin racks per pod   /2 pods per delivery   /   7.16 m cantilever
revised_cues.say: Each pod of four Vera Rubin racks spans seven point one six metres. The receiving lane handles two pods per delivery.
revised_cues.caption: Each pod of four Vera Rubin racks spans 7.16 metres. The receiving lane handles two pods per delivery.

revised_cues.title: Annular store
revised_cues.spec: 6,524 m³   /   water with 25% propylene glycol by volume
revised_cues.say: The annulus holds over sixty-five hundred cubic metres of water with twenty-five percent propylene glycol.
revised_cues.caption: The annulus holds over 6,500 m³ of water with 25% propylene glycol.

revised_cues.title: Generator support
revised_cues.spec: 94.5 t per assumed turbine set   /   independent support ring
revised_cues.say: Each turbine package has an assumed mass of ninety-four and a half tonnes, carried on independent rail girders.
revised_cues.caption: Each turbine package has an assumed mass of 94.5 t, carried on independent rail girders.

revised_cues.title: Emergency generation
revised_cues.say: Four standby diesels cover seven megawatts of priority computing. Cat’s thirty-five sixteen C is the reference.
revised_cues.caption: Four standby diesels cover 7 MW of priority computing. Cat’s 3516C is the reference.

revised_cues.title: Propane turbine generators
revised_cues.spec: Design 2 × 25 MW   /   GE LM2500 DLE reference
revised_cues.say: Two propane turbines, twenty-five megawatts each. G E’s L M twenty-five hundred D L E rates twenty-two point seven on natural gas.
revised_cues.caption: Two propane turbines, 25 MW each by design. GE’s LM2500 DLE reference rates 22.7 MW net on natural gas at ISO conditions.

revised_cues.title: Normal operating envelope
revised_cues.spec: 50 MW gross   /   4 MW auxiliaries   /   46 MW IT ceiling
revised_cues.say: Four megawatts for auxiliaries leave forty-six for computing. One option runs two hundred thirty-five racks flat out, twenty-one spare.
revised_cues.caption: 4 MW for auxiliaries leave 46 MW for computing. One option runs 235 racks flat out, 21 spare.

thermal.title: Inside the thermal store
thermal.say: Between the silo walls, cool water and glycol sit below a warmer layer of the same mixture.
thermal.caption: Between the silo walls, cool water and glycol sit below a warmer layer of the same mixture.

thermal.title: Rack heat enters the store
thermal.say: Each pod draws cool liquid from the bottom. Its C D U takes heat from the separate rack loop. Warm liquid returns at the top.
thermal.caption: Each pod draws cool liquid from the bottom. Its CDU takes heat from the separate rack loop. Warm liquid returns at the top.

thermal.title: Dry coolers recharge the store
thermal.say: The dry coolers draw from the warm upper layer, reject heat to the outside air, and send cooled liquid back near the floor.
thermal.caption: The dry coolers draw from the warm upper layer, reject heat to the outside air, and send cooled liquid back near the floor.

thermal.title: Thermal ride-through
thermal.spec: 10 K usable swing   /   51.25 MW design heat load
thermal.say: With circulation available, a ten-kelvin swing in the stratified store gives seventy-six minutes of modelled cooling ride-through at full design heat load.
thermal.caption: With circulation available, a 10 K swing in the stratified store gives 76 minutes of modelled cooling ride-through at full design heat load.
